Properties: bool useMin
If true, the value cannot be set lower than the 'minValue' (useDefaultBelowMin overrides this).
bool useMax
If true, the value cannot be set higher than the 'maxValue' (useDefaultAboveMax overrides this).
bool useDefaultBelowMin
If true, trying to set a value below the 'minValue' will override with the 'defaultValue'.
bool useDefaultAboveMax
If true, trying to set a value below the 'maxValue' will override with the 'defaultValue'.
float defaultValue
The default value for this parameter.
float minValue
The minimum value for this parameter.
float maxValue
The maximum value for this parameter.
